title: Remote full gates doc describes a recognized check-record import that does not exist
outcome: docs/features/remote-full-gates.md states accurately that no typed importer of a remote run as a recognized check record exists today, that remote full gates are evidence under the evidence-only procedure, and that landing gates and test-bound acceptance credit come from the evaluating host's own recorded checks; the doc names the missing capability as future work instead of describing it as available.
acceptance: Remote full gates doc describes a recognized check-record import that does not exist is done
